tools.name: domain_diagnose
tools.description: Runs a comprehensive health check on a public domain: SPF / DKIM / DMARC for the headline score, plus optional details on email-auth adjacent records (MX, BIMI, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, DKIM key length), DNS infrastructure (NS, DNSSEC, CAA, AAAA, SOA, TXT), web security (HTTPS, certificate, HSTS, HTTP/2-3,

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: domain_diagnose · Private data: domain_diagnose · Public sink: domain_diagnose.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: domain_diagnose · Private data: domain_diagnose · Public sink: domain_diagnose

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
